hero.bio: I design social content, performance ads, emails, ebooks and websites that communicate clearly and perform. 7+ years with public institutions and private brands, grounded in UX/UI and an AI-assisted workflow.

work.title: Work
work.intro: A selection by company. Each carousel counts as one piece.
work.empty: No pieces of this format in the selection.

services.title: What I do
services.intro: From carousels and reels to ads, emails, ebooks and websites. All designed as a system, to produce a lot without losing consistency.

items.title: Social media
items.text: Carousels, posts, stories and reels. One well-built template and many consistent pieces from it.

items.title: Performance ads
items.text: Paid campaign assets in every size, with variants to test messages.

items.title: Email marketing
items.text: Responsive campaigns and templates for institutional and commercial communication.

items.title: Ebooks and documents
items.text: Lead magnets, one-pagers and presentations with a clear hierarchy for quick reading.

items.title: WordPress websites
items.text: Design and build of sites with WordPress and Elementor, responsive and easy to maintain.

items.title: Figma systems
items.text: Components and templates that organise production and keep the brand consistent across channels.

process.title: Process + AI
process.intro: AI speeds up production; the design judgement is still mine.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: I understand the goal, the channel and how it will be measured before opening a file.

steps.title: System
steps.text: I build templates and components in Figma so each new piece comes out fast and consistent.

steps.title: AI-assisted production
steps.text: I use Claude Code, ChatGPT and Antigravity to speed up variants, draft copy and layout.

steps.title: Delivery and tuning
steps.text: I review with the client, deliver in every format and adjust based on how the pieces perform.

about.title: About
bio: I studied Graphic Design at Universidad Nacional de Cuyo and specialised in digital and UX/UI design. Since 2021 I have designed ISCAMEN’s communication and, through Sette Agency, I work for private brands on social, ads, emails and websites.
I work closely with teams: from brief to final delivery, coordinating timelines and changes with each client.
about.photoAlt: Black and white halftone portrait of Franco Colucci, smiling, wearing a dark T-shirt.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Hiring for a role or have a project? Write to me and I’ll reply by email.
